status: Memoshi's proposed D89/D90 workload. Limits await acceptance; no Release/device gate-protocol measurement exists. Mac Debug W1/W2 and CLI diagnostics are recorded separately in the linked record, not used as p95 or gate evidence.

backends.role: reference and compatibility fallback (D89); measured and reported, held to the same limits before any fallback use

devices.role: second D80 reference device; same protocol and limits, reported separately

composition.provider: PiAI faux provider, model faux/faux-1, default options (no pacing). Each turn: response 1 is one codemode tool call whose `code` is the workload script, stopReason toolUse; response 2 is the text `ok`.
composition.storage: A fresh file-backed SQLite store in a new private directory per launch (Swift openSqliteStorage; Node openNodeSqliteStorage).

extensions.name: fixture.tools
extensions.contents: The six fixture tools below, replay safe, callers [tools].

extensions.name: fixture.policy
extensions.contents: pi.tool beforeTool returns no decision change and counts calls; afterTool returns no change. Stands in for the mandatory policy seam so every outer and nested call crosses a hook.

extensions.name: codemode
extensions.contents: createCodemodeTool(sandbox, models: false), wrapped only to read the clock around execute. Installed after Harness.open and the idle baseline; the registry is live.

sandbox.memoryLimitSource: docs/plan/04-architecture.md §4.7 sketch and upstream bench:codemode; the product iOS limit is not decided by this record
sandbox.wasmLoader: loadQuickJSWasm() wrapped to time module loads (WasmKit); unused by a backend with no wasm module

tools.name: issues_list
tools.result: Compact JSON {repo, state:"open", items:[{number, title:"Fixture issue <number>"}]} for number = 100+limit down to 101.

tools.name: issue_get
tools.result: Compact JSON with keys in this order: number; title "Fixture issue <n>"; state "open"; author "author-<(n % 3) + 1>"; labels ["fixture", n even ? "bug" : "feature"] + (n % 4 == 0 ? ["ui"] : []); createdAt "2026-10-<pad2(10+i)>T09:00:00Z"; updatedAt "2026-11-<pad2(((i*3) % 4) + 1)>T<pad2(10+i)>:00:00Z"; comments n % 9; body. i = n - 100.
tools.body: Lines joined by a newline, no trailing newline: "## Summary"; for p in 1...24 "Paragraph <pad2(p)> of issue <n>: the fixture text repeats until the body reaches its target size."; "## Tasks"; for t in 1...8 (t <= n % 5 ? "- [x] " : "- [ ] ") + "Task <t> for issue <n>".

tools.name: code_search
tools.result: Compact JSON {query, matches:[{path:"Sources/Module<KK>/File<KK>.swift", line:25}]} for KK = 01 up to maxResults.

tools.name: file_read
tools.valid: path == "Sources/Module<KK>/File<KK>.swift" with the same KK in 01...10
tools.result: Plain text, 1,000 lines of exactly 45 characters, each followed by a newline (46,000 bytes, under the 51,200-byte / 2,000-line default tool output limit). Line i: i % 25 == 0 ? "// TODO(memoshi): item <KK>-<pad4(i)> review needed." : "let v<KK>_<pad4(i)> = <pad4(i)> + <KK> // fixture code line".

tools.name: symbols_outline
tools.result: Compact JSON {files:[{path, symbols:960, firstSymbol:"v<KK>_0001", lastSymbol:"v<KK>_0999"}]} in request order.

tools.name: probe_mark
tools.result: Text "ok"; signals the harness that a W3 script reached its stop or limit phase.

workloads.name: issue-digest-5
workloads.role: Gate timing workload: requirements §4's durable script with 5 nested calls and phase-0 exit-demo step 6.
workloads.shape: 1 issues_list, then 4 parallel issue_get; JSON parse, sort, split/regex word counts; returns a 344-byte JSON string.

workloads.name: batch-read-12
workloads.role: Gate timing and memory-ceiling workload: 07-coding §10.1 batch search/read/summarize at the inline tool-output limit; 12 calls across 3 tools as in the CodeModeCard header example.
workloads.shape: 1 code_search, then 10 parallel file_read and 1 symbols_outline; multiline regex over 460,000 characters; returns a 150-byte JSON string.

workloads.name: stop-polling-loop
workloads.role: Interruption: Stop during an interrupt-polling JavaScript loop.

workloads.name: stop-native-sort
workloads.role: Interruption: Stop during a long native built-in (default Array.prototype.sort of 262,144 numbers), the P05-04 case.

workloads.name: memory-limit
workloads.role: Limit: allocation until the configured QuickJS memory limit fails the script.

protocol.build: Release, no debugger attached (EnvironmentReading.debuggerAttached false), installed signed host app on the device.
protocol.environmentGates: Before each launch: device unlocked, host in the foreground, Low Power Mode off, thermalState nominal (wait and record otherwise), no other measured host running. Charging state and OS build recorded.
protocol.configuration: device × backend × workload; every launch is a fresh process started by the driver, which enforces a per-launch deadline (120 s for W1/W2, 300 s for W3*) and records a missed deadline as a failed launch.
launchW1W2: Open a fresh store, the faux provider, fixture.tools and fixture.policy, Harness.open, configure faux/faux-1 (unmeasured).
Idle 2,000 ms; read the idle baseline footprint.
Code Mode initialisation (measured, codemodeInitMs): construct CodemodeSandbox, install the codemode extension. No VM may have started.
Cold turn: submit, wait. Sample mode cold.
Idle 1,500 ms; warm-up turn (recorded, not a sample).
Idle 1,500 ms; warm turn. Sample mode warm.
Idle 1,500 ms; read the final footprint (retained warm state, pool included).
launchW3: Same composition, idle baseline and initialisation.

Idle 1,500 ms; the W3 turn. W3a/W3b: after probe_mark fires, wait 100 ms, press Stop through Conversation.abort(), wait for the submission's terminal state and for the VM lifetime's exit. W3c: run to completion.
Idle 1,500 ms; isolation W1 turn, verified.
Idle 1,500 ms; read the final footprint.
protocol.statistic: Nearest-rank p95: sort the 10 samples ascending and take sample ceil(0.95 × 10) = 10, the maximum. Report every raw sample, median and maximum.
protocol.validity: A launch counts only when every turn verifies against expected.json, no VM started before the cold turn, the build is Release without a debugger, and the environment gates held. A verification failure fails the configuration; a root-caused harness defect may be fixed and the whole configuration rerun.

W1.boundary: codemode tool execute entry to return (TurnSample.codemodeMs)

W2.boundary: codemode tool execute entry to return (TurnSample.codemodeMs)

limits.incrementalFootprintRule: Per W1/W2 launch: max(final ledger_phys_footprint_peak, final phys_footprint) - idle baseline phys_footprint, warm pool and retained VMs included; the maximum over the 10 launches must not exceed the ceiling. W3 launches: the final phys_footprint after the isolation turn minus the idle baseline must not exceed the ceiling.

W3a.also: probe phase loop; no nested call after probe_mark; worker exit observed; isolation W1 verified

W3b.also: as W3a; workerExitedMs is recorded, not limited by this record (P05-04); a script that completed before Stop is not exercised

W3c.also: script fails naming the limit (out of memory or a sandbox failure), the host process survives, isolation W1 verified

limits.gateSubject: wasm2c must meet every limit on the iPhone 14 Pro for the D89/D46 Code Mode criterion. WasmKit results are always reported; WasmKit may serve as a fallback only after meeting the same limits.

results: One harness LaunchResult JSON line per launch (schema memoshi.codemode-workload.result.v1), retained with device, OS build, backend identity evidence, Pi_Swift revision, guest SHA-256 and, for wasm2c, generated-source digest and compiler settings.
